connectorUiConfig.title: Cloudflare (Using Blob Container) (via Codeless Connector Framework)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown:
The Cloudflare data connector provides the capability to ingest Cloudflare logs into Microsoft Sentinel using the Cloudflare Logpush and Azure Blob Storage. Refer to [Cloudflare documentation](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/about/) for more information.

NOTE: The Cloudflare (Using Blob Container) (via Codeless Connector Framework) data connector available in the solution requires the Azure Blob Storage account and the Microsoft Sentinel workspace to be in the same Azure subscription and the same Resource Group. Deploying across different subscriptions or resource groups may result in errors such as CreateDataFlowResources not defined during connector configuration.

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and Write permissions are required.

customs.name: Create a storage account and a container
customs.description: Before setting up logpush in Cloudflare, first create a storage account and a container in Microsoft Azure. Use [this guide](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/blobs/storage-blobs-introduction) to know more about Container and Blob. Follow the steps in the [documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/common/storage-account-create?tabs=azure-portal) to create an Azure Storage account.

customs.name: Generate a Blob SAS URL
customs.description: Create and Write permissions are required. Refer the [documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/translator/document-translation/how-to-guides/create-sas-tokens?tabs=Containers) to know more about Blob SAS token and url.

customs.name: Collecting logs from Cloudflare to your Blob container

columns.description: Destination IP address to which the Gateway DNS query was sent.

columns.name: DstPort
columns.description: The destination port used at the edge. The port changes based on the protocol used by the DNS query (for example, 0).

columns.name: EDEErrors
columns.description: List of returned Extended DNS Error Codes (for example, [2, 3]).

columns.name: EdgeCFConnectingO2O
columns.description: True if the request looped through multiple zones on the Cloudflare edge. This is considered an O2O request.

columns.name: EdgeColoCode
columns.description: IATA airport code of the Cloudflare data center that received or served the request.

columns.name: EdgeColoID
columns.description: Cloudflare edge data center ID.

columns.name: EdgeEndTimestamp
columns.description: Source timestamp when Cloudflare finished sending the HTTP response, or when the WebSocket connection closed.

columns.name: EdgePathingOp
columns.description: Indicates what type of response was issued for this request (unknown = no specific action).

columns.name: EdgePathingSrc
columns.description: Details how the request was classified based on security checks (unknown = no specific classification).

columns.name: EdgePathingStatus
columns.description: Indicates what data was used to determine the handling of this request (unknown = no data).

columns.name: EdgeRequestHost
columns.description: Host header on the request from the edge to the origin.

columns.name: EdgeResponseBodyBytes
columns.description: Size of the HTTP response body returned to clients.

columns.name: EdgeResponseBytes
columns.description: Number of bytes returned by the edge to the client.

columns.name: EdgeResponseCompressionRatio
columns.description: The edge response compression ratio is calculated as the ratio between the sizes of the original and compressed responses.

columns.name: EdgeResponseContentType
columns.description: Edge response Content-Type header value.

columns.name: EdgeResponseStatus
columns.description: HTTP response status code returned by Cloudflare to the client.

columns.name: EdgeServerIP
columns.description: IP of the edge server making a request to the origin. Possible responses are string in IPv4 or IPv6 format, or empty string. Empty string means that there was no request made to the origin server.

columns.name: EdgeStartTimestamp
columns.description: Source timestamp when Cloudflare received the HTTP request, or when the WebSocket connection was established.

columns.name: EdgeTimeToFirstByteMs
columns.description: Total view of Time To First Byte as measured at Cloudflare's edge. Starts after a TCP connection is established and ends when Cloudflare begins returning the first byte of a response to eyeballs. Includes TLS handshake time (for new connections) and origin response time.

columns.name: EDNSSubnet
columns.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address information corresponding to the EDNS Client Subnet (ECS) forwarded by recursive resolvers. Not all resolvers send this information.

columns.name: EDNSSubnetLength
columns.description: Size of the EDNS Client Subnet (ECS) in bits. For example, if the last octet of an IPv4 address is omitted (`192.0.2.x.`), the subnet length will be 24.

columns.name: EgressColoName
columns.description: The name of the Cloudflare data center from which traffic egressed to the origin.

columns.name: EgressIP
columns.description: Source IP used when egressing traffic from Cloudflare to the origin.

columns.name: EgressPort
columns.description: Source port used when egressing traffic from Cloudflare to the origin.

columns.name: EgressRuleID
columns.description: Identifier of the egress rule that was applied by the Secure Web Gateway, if any.

columns.name: EgressRuleName
columns.description: The name of the egress rule that was applied by the Secure Web Gateway, if any.

columns.name: Email
columns.description: Email address associated with the source event's user identity or client registration; for Access, the user who logged in.

columns.name: Entrypoint
columns.description: The name of the entrypoint class in which the Worker began execution.

columns.name: Error
columns.description: Source-reported error details, such as an SSH error or an MCP request failure.

columns.name: Event
columns.description: Dataset-specific event value: a Spectrum connection event (such as connect, disconnect, or tlsError), or details of the event that triggered a Worker.

columns.name: EventDetails
columns.description: Zaraz log event details.

columns.name: EventTimestampMs
columns.description: The timestamp of when the event was received, in milliseconds.

columns.name: EventType
columns.description: Source event category. Workers uses the invocation trigger, Turnstile uses the challenge outcome, Account Abuse Protection uses the user action, and Zaraz uses its log event name.

columns.name: Exceptions
columns.description: List of uncaught exceptions during the invocation.

columns.name: FileInfo
columns.description: Information about files detected within the HTTP request.

columns.name: FinalDisposition
columns.description: Email Security threat classification of the message, such as malicious, suspicious, spoof, spam, or bulk. Unset/none values depend on the source dataset.

columns.name: FindingTypeDisplayName
columns.description: Human-readable name of the finding type (for example, 'File Publicly Accessible Read Only').

columns.name: FindingTypeID
columns.description: UUID of the finding type in Cloudflare's system.

columns.name: FindingTypeSeverity
columns.description: Severity of the finding type (for example, 'High').

columns.name: ForensicCopyID
columns.description: The unique ID for this particular forensic copy.

columns.name: ForensicCopyStatus
columns.description: Status of any associated forensic copies that may have been captured during the request.

columns.name: From
columns.description: Email address in the sender-provided From header; post-delivery events refer to the original message.

columns.name: FromName
columns.description: Display name in the sender-provided From header; post-delivery events refer to the original message.

columns.name: GatewayRequestID
columns.description: Cloudflare request ID, as found in Gateway logs.

columns.name: GREChecksum
columns.description: Value of the Checksum header field in the GRE packet.

columns.name: GREEtherType
columns.description: Value of the EtherType header field in the GRE packet.

columns.name: GREHeaderLength
columns.description: Length of the GRE packet header, in bytes.

columns.name: GREKey
columns.description: Value of the Key header field in the GRE packet.

columns.name: GRESequenceNumber
columns.description: Value of the Sequence Number header field in the GRE packet.

columns.name: GREVersion
columns.description: Value of the Version header field in the GRE packet.

columns.name: Headers
columns.description: HTTP header data. DLP forensic copies contain selected request/response header key-value pairs; Sinkhole events contain request headers with source-defined value formatting.

columns.name: Host
columns.description: HTTP host associated with the event: the requested host for request logs, or the host where Page Shield observed the resource.

columns.name: HTTPHost
columns.description: Content of the host header in the HTTP request.

columns.name: HTTPMethod
columns.description: HTTP method of the Gateway request or DEX application test.

columns.name: HTTPStatusCode
columns.description: HTTP status returned by Gateway or observed by a DEX HTTP test. Gateway uses 0 when no response was returned.

columns.name: HTTPVersion
columns.description: Version name for the HTTP request.

columns.name: ICMPChecksum
columns.description: Value of the Checksum header field in the ICMP packet.

columns.name: ICMPCode
columns.description: Value of the Code header field in the ICMP packet.

columns.name: ICMPType
columns.description: Value of the Type header field in the ICMP packet.

columns.name: ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of an audit log.

columns.name: IngressColoName
columns.description: The name of the Cloudflare data center to which traffic ingressed.

columns.name: InitialCategoryIDs
columns.description: ID or IDs of category that the queried domains belongs to (for example, [7,12,28,122,129,163]).

columns.name: InitialCategoryNames
columns.description: Name or names of category that the queried domains belongs to (for example, ['Photography', 'Weather']).

columns.name: InitialResolvedIPs
columns.description: The IPs used to correlate existing FQDN matching policy between Gateway DNS and Gateway proxy.

columns.name: InstanceID
columns.description: UUID of the finding in Cloudflare's system.

columns.name: IntegrationDisplayName
columns.description: Human-readable name of the integration (for example, 'My Google Workspace Integration').

columns.name: IntegrationID
columns.description: UUID of the integration in Cloudflare's system.

columns.name: IntegrationPolicyVendor
columns.description: Human-readable vendor name of the integration's policy (for example, 'Google Workspace Standard Policy').

columns.name: Interface
columns.description: Entry point or interface of the audit log.

columns.name: InternalDNSFallbackStrategy
columns.description: The fallback strategy applied over the internal DNS response. Empty if no fallback strategy was applied.

columns.name: InternalDNSRCode
columns.description: The return code sent back by the internal DNS service.

columns.name: InternalDNSViewID
columns.description: The DNS internal view identifier that was sent to the internal DNS service.

columns.name: InternalDNSZoneID
columns.description: The DNS zone identifier returned by the internal DNS service.

columns.name: IP
columns.description: Zaraz incoming request client IP address.

columns.name: IPAddress
columns.description: The IP address of the client.

columns.name: IPDestinationAddress
columns.description: Value of the Destination Address header field in the IPv4 or IPv6 packet.

columns.name: IPDestinationSubnet
columns.description: Computed subnet of the Destination Address header field in the IPv4 or IPv6 packet (/24 for IPv4; /64 for IPv6).

columns.name: IpFirewall
columns.description: Whether IP Firewall was enabled at time of connection.

columns.name: IPFragmentOffset
columns.description: Value of the Fragment Offset header field in the IPv4 or IPv6 packet.

columns.name: IPHeaderLength
columns.description: Length of the IPv4 or IPv6 packet header, in bytes.

columns.name: IPMoreFragments
columns.description: Value of the More Fragments header field in the IPv4 or IPv6 packet.

columns.name: IPProtocol
columns.description: Value of the Protocol header field in the IPv4 or IPv6 packet.

columns.name: IPProtocolName
columns.description: Name of the protocol specified by the Protocol header field in the IPv4 or IPv6 packet.

columns.name: IPSourceAddress
columns.description: Value of the Source Address header field in the IPv4 or IPv6 packet.

columns.name: IPSourceSubnet
columns.description: Computed subnet of the Source Address header field in the IPv4 or IPv6 packet (/24 for IPv4; /64 for IPv6).

columns.name: IPTotalLength
columns.description: Total length of the IPv4 or IPv6 packet, in bytes.

columns.name: IPTotalLengthBuckets
columns.description: Total length of the IPv4 or IPv6 packet, in bytes, with the last two digits truncated.

columns.name: IPTTL
columns.description: Value of the TTL header field in the IPv4 packet or the Hop Limit header field in the IPv6 packet.

columns.name: IPTTLBuckets
columns.description: Value of the TTL header field in the IPv4 packet or the Hop Limit header field in the IPv6 packet, with the last digit truncated.

columns.name: IPv4Checksum
columns.description: Value of the Checksum header field in the IPv4 packet.

columns.name: IPv4DontFragment
columns.description: Value of the Don't Fragment header field in the IPv4 packet.

columns.name: IPv4DSCP
columns.description: Value of the Differentiated Services Code Point header field in the IPv4 packet.

columns.name: IPv4ECN
columns.description: Value of the Explicit Congestion Notification header field in the IPv4 packet.

columns.name: IPv4Identification
columns.description: Value of the Identification header field in the IPv4 packet.

columns.name: IPv4Options
columns.description: List of Options numbers included in the IPv4 packet header.

columns.name: IPv6DSCP
columns.description: Value of the Differentiated Services Code Point header field in the IPv6 packet.

columns.name: IPv6ECN
columns.description: Value of the Explicit Congestion Notification header field in the IPv6 packet.

columns.name: IPv6ExtensionHeaders
columns.description: List of Extension Header numbers included in the IPv6 packet header.

columns.name: IPv6FlowLabel
columns.description: Value of the Flow Label header field in the IPv6 packet.

columns.name: IPv6Identification
columns.description: Value of the Identification extension header field in the IPv6 packet.

columns.name: IsIsolated
columns.description: Whether the HTTP request or network session originated from an isolated browser.

columns.name: IsResponseCached
columns.description: Response comes from cache or not.

columns.name: JA3Hash
columns.description: The MD5 hash of the JA3 fingerprint used to profile SSL/TLS clients. Available only for Bot Management customers. To enable this feature, contact your account team.

columns.name: JA4
columns.description: JA4 fingerprint used to identify characteristics of the TLS client.

columns.name: JA4Signals
columns.description: Inter-request statistics computed for this JA4 fingerprint. JA4Signals field is organized in key:value pairs, where values are numbers. Available only for Bot Management customers. To enable this feature, contact your account team.

columns.name: Kind
columns.description: The kind of event, currently only possible values are: firewall.

columns.name: LastKnownGoodColoCode
columns.description: IATA airport code of colo client connected to.

columns.name: LeakedCredentialCheckResult
columns.description: Result of the check for leaked credentials. Possible results are: password_leaked | username_and_password_leaked | username_password_similar | username_leaked | clean.

columns.name: Links
columns.description: List of links detected in this message, benign or otherwise; limited to 100 in total.

columns.name: Location
columns.description: Name of the location the DNS request is coming from. Location is created by the customer (for example, 'Office NYC').

columns.name: LocationID
columns.description: UUID of the location the DNS request is coming from. Location is created by the customer (for example, '7bdc7a9c-81d3-4816-8e56-000000000000').

columns.name: Logs
columns.description: List of console messages emitted during the invocation.

columns.name: NELType
columns.description: Source Type field renamed by the connector. For Network Error Logging this is the error type within Phase; for browser-isolation events it is the user action type, such as copy or paste.

columns.name: MatchedCategoryIDs
columns.description: ID or IDs of category that the domain was matched with the policy (for example, [7,12,28,122,129,163]).

columns.name: MatchedCategoryNames
columns.description: Name or names of category that the domain was matched with the policy (for example, ['Photography', 'Weather']).

columns.name: MatchedIndicatorFeedIDs
columns.description: ID or IDs of indicator feed(s) that the domain was matched with the policy (for example, [7,12]).

columns.name: MatchedIndicatorFeedNames
columns.description: Name or names of indicator feed(s) that the domain was matched with the policy (for example, ['Vendor Malware Feed', 'Vendor CoC Feed']).

columns.name: MatchIndex
columns.description: Rules match index in the chain. The last matching rule will have MatchIndex 0. If another rule matched before the last one, it will have MatchIndex 1. The same applies to any other matching rules, which will have a MatchIndex value of 2, 3, and so on.

columns.name: MessageDeliveryMode
columns.description: The message's mode of transport to Email Security. Possible values are unset | api | direct | bcc | journal | retroScan.

columns.name: MessageID
columns.description: Value of the email Message-ID header; post-delivery events refer to the original message.

columns.name: Metadata
columns.description: Additional source-specific metadata. Audit and firewall events use key-value information; browser-isolation actions and AI Gateway requests carry their own contextual metadata.

columns.name: Method
columns.description: Request method: an HTTP method for Sinkhole events or a JSON-RPC method, such as tools/call, for MCP Portal events.

columns.name: MitigationReason
columns.description: Reason for applying a mitigation to the packet, if any. Possible values are BLOCKED | RATE_LIMITED |UNEXPECTED | CHALLENGE_NEEDED | CHALLENGE_PASSED | NOT_FOUND | OUT_OF_SEQUENCE | ALREADY_CLOSED.

columns.name: MitigationScope
columns.description: Whether the packet matched a local or global mitigation, if any. Possible values are local | global.

columns.name: MitigationSystem
columns.description: Which Cloudflare system sampled the packet. Possible values are dosd | flowtrackd | magic-firewall.

columns.name: NewValue
columns.description: Contains the new value for the audited item.

columns.name: Offramp
columns.description: Traffic destination type. Zero Trust network sessions may identify INTERNET, MAGIC, CFD_TUNNEL, WARP, or MESH.

columns.name: OldValue
columns.description: Contains the old value for the audited item.

columns.name: Origin
columns.description: The origin of the message. Possible values are unset | internal | external | secondPartyInternal | thirdPartyInternal | outbound.

columns.name: OriginalSender
columns.description: The original sender address as determined by Email Security mail processing (for example, 'firstlast@cloudflare.com').

columns.name: OriginatorRayID
columns.description: The Ray ID of the request that issued the challenge. Solved challenge actions populate this field. Logpush returns `00` without an originator Ray ID.

columns.name: OriginBytes
columns.description: The number of bytes read from the origin by Spectrum.

columns.name: OriginDNSResponseTimeMs
columns.description: Time taken to receive a DNS response for an origin name. Usually takes a few milliseconds, but may be longer if a CNAME record is used.

columns.name: OriginIP
columns.description: IP address of the origin server or network-session destination.

columns.name: OriginPort
columns.description: Transport port of the origin server or network-session destination.

columns.name: OriginProto
columns.description: Transport protocol used by origin; tcp | udp | unix.

columns.name: OriginRequestHeaderSendDurationMs
columns.description: Time taken to send request headers to origin after establishing a connection. Note that this value is usually 0.

columns.name: OriginResponseBytes
columns.description: Deprecated source field. Number of bytes returned by the origin server. Interpret with OriginResponseStatus; 0 and 304 responses can require different handling when calculating origin-served bytes.

columns.name: OriginResponseDurationMs
columns.description: Upstream response time, measured from the first datacenter that receives a request. Includes time taken by Argo Smart Routing and Tiered Cache, plus time to connect and receive a response from origin servers. This field replaces OriginResponseTime.

columns.name: OriginResponseHeaderReceiveDurationMs
columns.description: Time taken for origin to return response headers after Cloudflare finishes sending request headers.

columns.name: OriginResponseHTTPExpires
columns.description: Value of the origin 'expires' header in RFC1123 format.

columns.name: OriginResponseHTTPLastModified
columns.description: Value of the origin 'last-modified' header in RFC1123 format.

columns.name: OriginResponseStatus
columns.description: HTTP status code received from the origin. A value of 0 means no origin response was received; for HTTP request logs, Worker subrequests can also produce this value.

columns.name: OriginSSLProtocol
columns.description: SSL (TLS) protocol used to connect to the origin.

columns.name: OriginTCPHandshakeDurationMs
columns.description: Time taken to complete TCP handshake with origin. This will be 0 if an origin connection is reused.

columns.name: OriginTcpRtt
columns.description: The TCP round-trip time in nanoseconds between Spectrum and the origin.

columns.name: OriginTLSCertificateIssuer
columns.description: The issuer of the origin TLS certificate.

columns.name: OriginTLSCertificateValidationResult
columns.description: The result of validating the TLS certificate of the origin. Possible values are VALID | EXPIRED | REVOKED | HOSTNAME_MISMATCH | NONE | UNKNOWN.

columns.name: OriginTLSCipher
columns.description: TLS cipher suite used in the connection between Cloudflare and the origin.

columns.name: OriginTlsFingerprint
columns.description: SHA256 hash of origin certificate. An unknown SHA256 hash is returned as an empty string.

columns.name: OriginTLSHandshakeDurationMs
columns.description: TLS handshake duration between Cloudflare and the origin, in milliseconds. HTTP request logs report 0 when an origin connection is reused.

columns.name: OriginTlsMode
columns.description: If and how the upstream connection is encrypted; unknown | off | flexible | full | strict.

columns.name: OriginTlsProtocol
columns.description: The TLS version negotiated between Spectrum and the origin; unknown | none | SSLv3 | TLSv1 | TLSv1.1 | TLSv1.2 | TLSv1.3.

columns.name: OriginTlsStatus
columns.description: The state of the TLS session from Spectrum to the origin; UNKNOWN | OK | INTERNAL_ERROR | INVALID_CONFIG | INVALID_SNI | HANDSHAKE_FAILED | KEYLESS_RPC.

columns.name: OriginTLSVersion
columns.description: TLS protocol version used in the connection between Cloudflare and the origin.

columns.name: OSVersion
columns.description: The operating system version at the time of upload.

columns.name: Outcome
columns.description: Dataset-specific result: pass/drop for Network Analytics packets, or the Worker invocation outcome, such as ok, canceled, exception, or unknown.

columns.name: OverrideIP
columns.description: Overridden IP of the network session, if any.

columns.name: OverridePort
columns.description: Overridden port of the network session, if any.

columns.name: OwnerID
columns.description: The identifier of the user that was acting or was acted on behalf of. If a user did the action themselves, this value will be the same as the ActorID.

columns.name: PageURL
columns.description: The page URL the violation was seen on.

columns.name: ParentRayID
columns.description: Ray ID of the parent request if this request was made using a Worker script.

columns.name: Password
columns.description: The request password.

columns.name: Payload
columns.description: Captured content: base64-encoded request/response data for DLP forensic copies, or asciicast v2 SSH session data, including exec commands, for SSH logs.

columns.name: Phase
columns.description: Dataset-specific phase: dns, connection, application, or unknown for a Network Error Logging failure; request or response for a DLP forensic copy.

columns.name: PolicyID
columns.description: Identifier of the policy associated with the event: applied Gateway rule, violated Page Shield policy, or evaluated device posture check.

columns.name: PolicyName
columns.description: Name of the Gateway policy applied to the request or DNS query, when present.

columns.name: PostureCheckName
columns.description: The name of the posture check associated with this device posture result.

columns.name: PostureCheckType
columns.description: The type of the Zero Trust client check or service provider check.

columns.name: PostureEvaluatedResult
columns.description: Whether this posture upload passes the associated posture check, given the requirements posture check at the time of the timestamp.

columns.name: PostureExpectedJSON
columns.description: JSON object of what the posture check expects from the Zero Trust client.

columns.name: PostureReceivedJSON
columns.description: JSON object of what the Zero Trust client actually uploads.

columns.name: PrivateAppAUD
columns.description: The private app AUD, if any.

columns.name: ProgramFinishDatetime
columns.description: The timestamp in UTC of the SSH program termination. This is empty until the program ends.

columns.name: ProgramID
columns.description: The SSH program ID. A single SSH session can have multiple programs running.

columns.name: ProgramStartDatetime
columns.description: The timestamp in UTC of the SSH program creation.

columns.name: ProgramType
columns.description: The SSH program being run. The options are 'shell': opens an interactive terminal, 'exec': execute a single specified command, 'x11': is for an interactive graphical environment, 'direct-tcpip': direct tunneling, 'forwarded-tcpip': reverse tunneling.

columns.name: Protocol
columns.description: Source protocol representation: DNS transport, a TCP/UDP/ICMP network-session label, IDS layer-4 protocol (or any for a lower-layer detection), or a protocol number in network flow logs.

columns.name: ProtocolState
columns.description: State of the packet in the context of the protocol, if any. Possible values are OPEN | NEW | CLOSING | CLOSED.

columns.name: ProxyEndpoint
columns.description: Proxy endpoint used for the HTTP request or network session, when present.

columns.name: ProxyProtocol
columns.description: Which form of proxy protocol is applied to the given connection; off | v1 | v2 | simple.

columns.name: PTY
columns.description: This is used by certain programs types to synchronize local and remote SSH terminal state.

columns.name: PurposeJustificationPrompt
columns.description: Message prompted to the client when accessing the application.

columns.name: PurposeJustificationResponse
columns.description: Justification given by the client when accessing the application.

columns.name: Quarantined
columns.description: If the request content was quarantined.

columns.name: QueryCategoryIDs
columns.description: Union of all categories; Initial categories + Resolved IP categories + Cname intermediate categories

columns.name: QueryCategoryNames
columns.description: Union of all category names; Initial categories + Resolved IP categories + Cname intermediate categories

columns.name: QueryDO
columns.description: Indicates if the client is capable of handling a signed response (DNSSEC answer OK).

columns.name: QueryID
columns.description: Globally unique identifier of the query.

columns.name: QueryIndicatorFeedIDs
columns.description: ID or IDs of indicator feed(s) that the domain belongs to (for example, [7,12,28]).

columns.name: QueryIndicatorFeedNames
columns.description: Name or names of indicator feed(s) that the domain belongs to (for example, ['Vendor Malware Feed', 'Vendor CoC Feed', 'Vendor Phishing Feed']).

columns.name: QueryName
columns.description: DNS name queried by the client. Gateway uses a single dot for root-server queries.

columns.name: QueryNameReversed
columns.description: Query name in reverse (for example, 'com.example'). Cloudflare will surface '.' for root server queries in your logs.

columns.name: QueryRD
columns.description: Indicates if the client means a recursive query (Recursion Desired).

columns.name: QuerySize
columns.description: Size of the DNS query received from the client, in bytes.

columns.name: QueryTCP
columns.description: Indicates if the query from the client was made via TCP (if false, then UDP).

columns.name: QueryType
columns.description: Numeric DNS record type requested, such as 1 for A or 28 for AAAA.

columns.name: QueryTypeName
columns.description: The type of DNS query (for example, 'A', 'AAAA', 'MX', or 'TXT').

columns.name: R2Path
columns.description: The path to the object within the R2 bucket linked to this sinkhole that stores overflow body and header data. Blank if neither headers nor body was larger than 256 bytes.

columns.name: RayID
columns.description: Cloudflare request identifier; for WebSocket events, identifies the HTTP upgrade request.

columns.name: RCode
columns.description: The return code sent back by the DNS resolver.

columns.name: RData
columns.description: Deprecated source field. The rdata objects (for example, [{"type":"5","data":"dns-packet-placeholder..."}]).

columns.name: RedirectTargetURI
columns.description: Custom URI to which the user was redirected, if any.

columns.name: Ref
columns.description: The user-defined identifier for the rule triggered by this request. Use refs to label your rules individually alongside the Cloudflare-provided RuleID. You can set refs via the Rulesets API for some security products.

columns.name: Referer
columns.description: Contents of the referer header in the HTTP request.

columns.name: Referrer
columns.description: The referrer of the request.

columns.name: RegistrationID
columns.description: Identifier of the client device registration associated with the request, network session, or posture result.

columns.name: ReplyTo
columns.description: Email address portion of the Reply-To header provided by the sender (for example, 'firstlast@cloudflare.com').

columns.name: ReplyToName
columns.description: Name portion of the Reply-To header provided by the sender (for example, 'First Last').

columns.name: RequestContextCategoryIDs
columns.description: ID or IDs of the category that was sent to gateway in the EDNS request for filtering (for example, [7,12,28,122,129,163]).

columns.name: RequestContextCategoryNames
columns.description: Name or names of the category that was sent to gateway in the EDNS request for filtering (for example, ['Photography', 'Weather']).

columns.name: RequestHeaders
columns.description: Request header key-value data. HTTP request logs require Logpush custom fields to be configured; Zaraz events contain the incoming request headers.

columns.name: RequestID
columns.description: Cloudflare request ID. This might be empty on bypass action.

columns.name: ResolvedIPCategoryIDs
columns.description: ID or IDs of category that the ips in the response belongs to (for example, [7,12,28,122,129,163]).

columns.name: ResolvedIPCategoryNames
columns.description: Name or names of category that the ips in the response belongs to (for example, ['Photography', 'Weather']).

columns.name: ResolvedIPContinentCodes
columns.description: Continent code of each resolved IP, if any (for example ['NA', 'EU']).

columns.name: ResolvedIPCountryCodes
columns.description: Country code of each resolved IP, if any (for example ['US', 'PT']).

columns.name: ResolverDecision
columns.description: Result of the DNS query (for example, 'overrideForSafeSearch').

columns.name: ResourceID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the resource within Cloudflare's system.

columns.name: ResourceRecords
columns.description: The rdata objects (for example, [{"type":"5","data":"dns-packet-placeholder..."}]).

columns.name: ResourceRecordsJSON
columns.description: String that represents the JSON array with the returned resource records (for example, '[{"name": "example.com", "type": "CNAME", "class": "IN", "ttl": 3600, "rdata": "cname.example.com."}]').

columns.name: ResourceType
columns.description: Type of the resource changed in an audit event, or the Page Shield resource that violated a directive (script, connection, or other).

columns.name: ResponseCached
columns.description: Whether the response was cached or not.

columns.name: ResponseCachedStale
columns.description: Whether the response was cached stale. In other words, the TTL had expired and the upstream nameserver was not reachable.

columns.name: ResponseHeaders
columns.description: String key-value pairs for response headers. This field is populated based on Logpush Custom fields, which need to be configured.

columns.name: ResponseReason
columns.description: Additional context for the final DNS Firewall response.

columns.name: RuleEvaluationDurationMs
columns.description: The duration taken by Secure Web Gateway applying applicable Network, HTTP, and Egress rules to the network session in milliseconds.

columns.name: RuleID

connectorUiConfig.title: Cloudflare (Using Blob Container) (via Codeless Connector Framework)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown:
The Cloudflare data connector provides the capability to ingest Cloudflare logs into Microsoft Sentinel using the Cloudflare Logpush and Azure Blob Storage. Refer to [Cloudflare documentation](https://developers.cloudflare.com/logs/about/) for more information.

NOTE: The Cloudflare (Using Blob Container) (via Codeless Connector Framework) data connector available in the solution requires the Azure Blob Storage account and the Microsoft Sentinel workspace to be in the same Azure subscription and the same Resource Group. Deploying across different subscriptions or resource groups may result in errors such as CreateDataFlowResources not defined during connector configuration.

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and Write permissions are required.

Use [this guide](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/blobs/storage-blobs-introduction) to know more about Container and Blob. Follow the steps in the [documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/common/storage-account-create?tabs=azure-portal) to create an Azure Storage account.

customs.name: Generate a Blob SAS URL
customs.description: Create and Write permissions are required. Refer the [documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/translator/document-translation/how-to-guides/create-sas-tokens?tabs=Containers) to know more about Blob SAS token and url.

customs.name: Collecting logs from Cloudflare to your Blob container

properties.description: Detects post requests to unusual extensions.
properties.query:
Cloudflare
| where HttpRequestMethod in~ ('POST', 'PUT')
| where tostring(HttpStatusCode) startswith '2'
| where DstBytes != 0 or SrcBytes != 0
| extend fe = extract(@'.*(\.\w+)$', 1, ClientRequestURI)
| where fe in~ ('.jpg', '.jpeg', '.gif', '.png', '.icon', '.ico', '.xml', '.swf', '.svg', '.ppt', '.pttx', '.doc', '.docx', '.rtf', '.pdf', '.tif', '.zip', '.mov')

properties.description: Detects client requests to unusual client request.
properties.query:

| where HttpRequestMethod =~ 'GET'
| where DstBytes != 0 or SrcBytes != 0
| where ClientRequestURI has_any ('/admin', '/admin.php', 'wp-admin', '.htaccess', '/etc/shadow', '/etc/passwd', '/etc/hosts', '/etc/ssh/')

properties.description: Detects client requests to unusual URI.
Detects WAF "Allowed" action on threat events.
properties.query:
Cloudflare
| where isnotempty(WAFRuleID) or isnotempty(WAFRuleMessage)
| where WAFAction =~ 'Allow'
| extend CompleteUrl = strcat(HttpRequestHeaderHost,ClientRequestPath)

properties.displayName: Cloudflare - XSS probing pattern in request
properties.query:
let s_threshold = 3;
Cloudflare
| where HttpRequestMethod in~ ('POST', 'PUT')
| extend susp_ch = countof(ClientRequestURI, '%00')
| where ClientRequestURI matches regex @'(alert\()|(alert\%28)|(String\.fromCharCode\()|(expression\(alert)' or susp_ch > s_threshold 
| extend CompleteUrl = strcat(HttpRequestHeaderHost,ClientRequestPath)

properties.displayName: Cloudflare - XSS probing pattern in request
